line: Bed drawer: the Stay tile now shows the day of the stay, for example "Day 37".
Patient search movement rows now show surname first.
You can now dismiss the note about an uncertain save once you have read it.
Add patient now shows only on desks that are allowed to add a patient.
If two people close the same ward, the second now sees who closed it first and can try again.
A coordinator can now record that a person has left, from the Discharges sheet.
Help adds spelling fixes, grouped words, accessibility, first-visit hints and printable desk guides.
Release now waits until the shared save is confirmed, and Activity times follow the ward clock.
Acknowledge visible now explains what it covers, and booking a planned admission shows the patient you chose.
On a phone, the bed meeting agenda now opens, and opening a referral moves you straight into it.
The patient list shows a referral's recorded legal status instead of 'Not recorded'.
Help now opens on How do I…: your desk's common tasks, each with its steps and a Go there link.
Notices pause while you read them, warnings stay until you close them, and Alt+N jumps to the newest one.
Search now forgives small typos and finds Help answers, contacts and suburbs; there are fewer search boxes.
Cancelling community transport now names the patient, and the desk guides match what each desk can open.
Legal form times now show only as typed, such as "Ends 15:42 as typed", never as a countdown.
Settings: Restore now names all twelve rules, and Export saves only the saved rules.
Names now read surname first in the downtime pack, chronology file, community record and referral slide-out.
Capacity's ward panel only offers pages your desk can open.
Legal forms: Record the time written now takes a typed 24-hour time, as Record a form does.
